skinInTheGame.title: The operator puts their capital in first.
skinInTheGame.description: Before the pool accepts the first USDC from investors, the operator deposits 5% of the funding goal into a PDA. Incentives are aligned from block zero.
skinInTheGame.card1Description: 5% from the operator stays locked in the Pool Vault. Cannot be withdrawn until the sales cycle.
skinInTheGame.card2Description: The Anchor program transitions from Pending → Funding ONLY after the deposit. Without it, the pool doesn't accept capital.
skinInTheGame.card3Description: Every deposit has a verifiable signature on Solscan. Radical transparency.
skinInTheGame.splitNote: Operator receives their share of profit proportional to 5%. Investors receive proportional to 95%.

receive.q: How do I receive my returns?
receive.a: In USDC, automatically, when the property is sold. The smart contract distributes proportionally to token holders without manual intervention.

risk.q: What if construction delays or the property doesn't sell?
risk.a: The operator put 5% of their own capital locked in the pool from the start (skin-in-the-game). If there's a loss, they lose first. Investors only lose after the operator's 5% has been completely consumed.

crypto.q: Do I need to understand crypto?
crypto.a: No. You can login with Google and the platform creates your wallet automatically. You only need USDC to invest — you can buy it via bank transfer on some exchanges.

documents.q: Are the properties real? Can I see the deed?
documents.a: Yes. Each pool has public documents: property deed, appraisal report, before/after photos, and renovation timeline. Everything linked directly from the marketplace.

fees.a: 1% on the investment (protocol fee, deducted at purchase) + Solana gas (a few cents per transaction). No hidden fees, no performance fee on exit.
